pages.title: Zero-length edges and zero spread
pages.text:
Zero-length edges and zero spread
A repeated adjacent vertex creates a zero interpolation interval.
A zero-spread point set
contains no orientation information.

pages.title: Nonunique alignment
pages.text:
Nonunique alignment
A degenerate cross-product matrix can make the minimizing rotation nonunique.
A
minimizing transformation describes the stated paired coordinates; it does not establish
anatomical correspondence.

Residual components

segmentation.
Arclength fractions supply boundary positions, not validated landmarks.
